pandoc.purpose: Advanced Markdown to DOCX/EPUB/HTML conversion when Story Skills build output is not enough
pandoc.trigger: custom reference DOCX, advanced conversion, or a publishing workflow that requires Pandoc features

libreoffice.purpose: Final DOCX formatting and visual proofing
libreoffice.trigger: a human-facing DOCX needs layout or style finishing

calibre.trigger: ebook delivery needs QA beyond the Story Skills build

ollama.purpose: Local/private fallback for bounded low-risk AI tasks
ollama.trigger: privacy, Gemini quota, offline work, or batch experimentation

zotero.trigger: historical, scientific, legal, medical, political, or other source-heavy research

novelWriter.trigger: editing chapter prose in plain Markdown becomes uncomfortable

koboldCpp.trigger: compare alternate prose models without changing the canonical workflow

aeonTimeline.trigger: time travel, multi-generation chronology, or many simultaneous POV timelines exceed Markdown usability

mcp.trigger: a concrete remote service cannot be accessed cleanly through existing Antigravity tools
